'''Azuroth Khell''' was a [[Kalzerian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] born in the frigid hills of the [[Kost province]] on the planet [[Kalzeron]]. His primitive world was occupied by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces and he fled with a group so they could train and arm themselves to take back their world. However, while he was off-planet, the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] occurred and the Empire removed their forces from Kalzeron. Khell returned home but was labeled as a coward for fleeing the planet. Ostracized, he left and worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|First Galactic Civil War]]. He eventually was employed at [[Executive Results]] and was recommended to work for [[Saujutta-Ok-Topii]] directly. He was tasked with eliminating rivals to Saujutta-Ok-Topii's power.
